weather_report:
Subiaco wakes to a clear, hushed pre-dawn, the air a touch cool and the sky rinsed clean, waiting for first light. Forecasts show that clarity holding through sunrise and into the morning, so expect a day that feels bright and sharp-edged, with crisp shadows and little haze. Under an open sky the spring sun will gather strength quickly; UV will climb fast after breakfast, so plan on sun protection once the light turns brassy. It looks pleasant overall—cool now, then warming with a dry, easy feel—more a day for unhurried errands than endurance.

Dress in light layers you can shed by midmorning: long sleeves or a thin jumper at dawn, breathable fabrics beneath, sunglasses and a brimmed hat in your bag. Good moments today are the ordinary ones: an early wander for bread and coffee, watering the garden before the sun bites, hanging laundry to let the breeze do its quiet work, cycling short errands, or taking calls by an open window, shaded and bright at once.
